#!/bin/sh

OSCAD_LIST="openscad-nightly openscad"

TG=boat.scad

PROC_DESIGN=0
PROC_ROUNDED=1
PROC_ROUNDED_EMPTY=2
PROC_BULKHEAD=3
PROC_STEM=4
PROC_DECK=5

PARALLEL=3

PROC_BH_NB=66
PROC_ST_NB=67


OSCAD="";
for b in $OSCAD_LIST; do
  if [ "$(command -v $b)" != "" ]; then
    OSCAD="$b";
    echo "Using: $b";
    break;
  fi
done
if [ "$OSCAD" = "" ]; then
  echo "Missing openscad ... not found";
  exit 1;
fi


case "$1" in
  raw)
    ${OSCAD} -D processing=${PROC_DESIGN} ${TG}
    ;;

  rounded)
    ${OSCAD} -D processing=${PROC_ROUNDED} ${TG}
    ;;

  roundedempty)
    ${OSCAD} -D processing=${PROC_ROUNDED_EMPTY} ${TG}
    ;;

  bulkhead)
    ${OSCAD} -D processing=${PROC_BULKHEAD} ${TG}
    ;;

  stem)
    ${OSCAD} -D processing=${PROC_STEM} ${TG}
    ;;

  stl)
    ${OSCAD} -D processing=${PROC_BH_NB} -o bhs.echo ${TG};
    ${OSCAD} -D processing=${PROC_ST_NB} -o stem.echo ${TG};
    NBBH=`sed -e 's/.*://' bhs.echo`;
    NBST=`sed -e 's/.*://' stem.echo`;
    NBST=$(($NBST+1));
    rm -f bhs.echo stem.echo;

    PROC=0;
    FILES="";
    tmi=$(date -u +%s)

    I=1;
    while [ "$I" -le "$NBBH" ]; do
      echo "Processing bulkhead $I";
      ${OSCAD} -D processing=${PROC_BULKHEAD} 		\
        -D bhid=$I 				\
        -q -o bh-$I.stl ${TG} &
      FILES="$FILES bh-$I.stl";
      PROC=$(($PROC+1));
      if [ "$PROC" -eq "${PARALLEL}" ]; then
        echo "waiting to finish";
        PROC=0; wait;
        tmo=$(date -u +%s); echo "... $(($tmo-$tmi)) seconds";
      fi;
      I=$(($I+1));
    done;

    I=1;
    while [ "$I" -le "$NBST" ]; do
      echo "Processing stem $I";
      ${OSCAD} -D processing=${PROC_STEM} 		\
        -D stid=$I 				\
        -q -o stem-$I.stl ${TG} &
      FILES="$FILES stem-$I.stl";
      PROC=$(($PROC+1));
      if [ "$PROC" -eq "${PARALLEL}" ]; then
        echo "waiting...";
        PROC=0; wait;
        tmo=$(date -u +%s); echo "... $(($tmo-$tmi)) seconds";
      fi;
      I=$(($I+1));
    done;

    I=1;
    while [ "$I" -le "$NBST" ]; do
      echo "Processing deck $I";
      ${OSCAD} -D processing=${PROC_DECK} 		\
        -D stid=$I 				\
        -q -o deck-$I.stl ${TG} &
      FILES="$FILES deck-$I.stl";
      PROC=$(($PROC+1));
      if [ "$PROC" -eq "${PARALLEL}" ]; then
        echo "waiting...";
        PROC=0; wait;
        tmo=$(date -u +%s); echo "... $(($tmo-$tmi)) seconds";
      fi;
      I=$(($I+1));
    done;

    wait;
    tmo=$(date -u +%s); echo "done ... in $(($tmo-$tmi)) seconds";
    echo -n "Files: ";
    for f in $FILES; do echo -n " $f"; done;
    echo "";
    ;;
  *)
    echo ""
    echo "Usage: $0 {raw|rounded|roundedempty|bulkhead|stl}"
    echo "  raw               : Open $b for hull design (processing $PROC_RAW)"
    echo "  rounded           : Open $b for hull rounded (processing $PROC_ROUNDED)"
    echo "  roundedempty      : Open $b for empty hull rounded (processing $PROC_ROUNDED_EMPTY)"
    echo "  bulkhead          : Open $b for bulkhead (processing $PROC_BULKHEAD)"
    echo "  stem              : Open $b for stem (processing $PROC_STEM)"
    echo ""
    echo "  stl               : Generate all stl files automatically (parallelize: $PARALLEL)"
    echo ""
esac
